headline: The blocking defects are genuinely fixed and verified at ground truth, and every one of the four named prior survivors is now killed. But three of the four fixes are unprotected at their use sites — the central FALSE ALL-CLEAR fix is undone by a one-token edit with the suite 52/52 green, proven against live data — and the classifier fix did not reach the founding case in the SD's own charter.

THE_FOUNDING_CASE_STILL_DOES_NOT_CLASSIF.why: These match the SUBJECT regex (sms) but carry no predicate term (cover/reach/miss/get through/deliver/receive), so the loop falls through every class to null.
THE_FOUNDING_CASE_STILL_DOES_NOT_CLASSIF.conclusion: T1 STILL could not fire on the founding case in its own charter. The commit message states this bug in the past tense; the fix did not reach it.
THE_FOUNDING_CASE_STILL_DOES_NOT_CLASSIF.test_pattern: The two new questionClass tests assert on synthetic strings the author wrote ('Are we missing any texts?', 'did the texts get through'), not on any string drawn from the corpus. The fixtures were built from the same mental model as the fix, so they confirm the fix and miss the population - a control built on the assumption it is meant to check.

task_5_classifier_coverage_remeasure.additional_hazard: The watchdog body itself classifies AS sms-coverage. sms-coverage is therefore 100% watchdog noise plus one relay test, held apart only by an untested ordering (see M33).

failures.why_not: The SD is 2418 pure insertions (0 deletions) touching only lib/solomon, scripts/solomon, tests/unit/solomon, .github/workflows and .artifacts. It touches nothing under scripts/modules/complete-quick-fix, which that test imports.

conditions_to_clear_to_PASS: C1 (HIGH) - Test the null->undefined conversion AT THE CONSUMER: assert runSweep with a blind resolver yields UNKNOWN verdicts. Kills M49 and M50. Without this the SD's central fix does not survive its first refactor.
C2 (HIGH) - Test that resolveT3Facts does NOT clamp: assert reachedPatterns can exceed laneNamed as emitted BY THE RESOLVER. Kills M43. The current 'proof' test never calls the resolver.

C3 (HIGH) - Test resolveT1Facts directly with a lane double: automated excluded BEFORE classification, inbound-only, and coverage counted from the clusters actually built rather than derived by subtraction. Kills M33, M34, M35.

C4 (HIGH) - Either fix questionClass so the founding-case bodies classify, or amend the code comment and the receipt to state plainly that sms-coverage is not yet operational. The comment currently asserts a fix the corpus refutes, and a stale comment that explains away the signal is worse than no comment.

C5 (MEDIUM) - Test writeCandidates: the per-class cap, the truncation record being non-null when it fires, and the per-finding dedup_key. Kills M46, M47, M48. Commit 8a75a311cec's entire purpose is unguarded.
C6 (LOW) - Pin the T3 baseline-excludes-latest property (M17) and T3_MIN_READINGS (M11); production is sitting at exactly the M11 boundary today.
what_is_genuinely_fixed: Phantom columns - verified column-by-column against the live schema, independently of the author's account. retention_archive.payload and issue_patterns.pattern_name are ABSENT; the code's four verbatim selects all succeed. The sweep now runs and exits 0.
